evidence: Completed 5-minute decisions enter no earlier than the next open; native BBO decisions enter strictly after completed information intervals.
Funding settlements use the mark open observable at the event timestamp, with same-timestamp contract-open fallback only.
Structural targets are invariant to cost multipliers; the prior cost-moved-target run is explicitly hard-invalid.
Same-bar stop/target ambiguity is stop-first; gap stops use the adverse observed open; one global position is enforced.
All 1,536 preregistered policies failed development gates, so validation and sealed confirmation were not opened.
Hazard AUC 0.759331-0.807847; conditional direction AUC 0.544957-0.645932; perfect-direction oracle is diagnostic only.
